parsed.name: 串口文本行读取组件
parsed.description: 非物理软件组件，用于通过串口持续读取按行组织的文本数据并进行缓冲，支持线程模式和非线程模式。适合在实验系统中接收外部串口设备输出的 ASCII 或行式测量数据。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component for continuously reading line-based text data from a serial port and buffering it for use in threaded or non-threaded execution. It is suitable for receiving ASCII or other line-oriented measurement data from external serial devices in lab workflows.

actions.description: 清空内部行缓冲区并清除串口输入缓冲区。
actions.description_en: Clear the internal line buffer and the serial input buffer.

actions.description: 在非线程模式下读取并返回当前批次的行数据。
actions.description_en: Read and return the current batch of line data in non-threaded mode.

actions.description: 返回当前已累积的读取结果。
打开串口并在循环中持续读取数据，线程安全地更新已缓冲的行内容。
actions.description_en: Open the serial port and continuously read data in a loop, updating buffered lines in a thread-safe manner.

actions.description: 停止读取流程并关闭串口相关资源。
actions.description_en: Stop the reading process and close serial-port-related resources.
